business_problem: Indonesia's Universitas Terbuka (UT), with over 525,000 active students and growing, struggled to provide timely tutor support, risking student engagement, satisfaction, and retention.
solution_summary: Universitas Terbuka used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Document Intelligence to move core workloads off legacy infrastructure and into a more scalable Azure operating model. Application, integration, and data services were rehosted or re-platformed so teams could standardize deployment, improve resilience, and create a foundation for newer analytics or AI capabilities. It also connects with surrounding systems such as Microsoft Word, Learning management system, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. The tutor currently supports 500 classes and some 100,000 students.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Foundry
solution_components.role: Provides the managed environment for model orchestration, experimentation, and responsible AI operations.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Document Intelligence
solution_components.role: Extracts text, layout, and document fields before downstream AI or analytics processing.

solution_components.name: Azure Cosmos DB
solution_components.role: Persists low-latency application data, conversation state, or operational records.

solution_components.name: Azure Kubernetes Service
solution_components.role: Hosts scalable APIs, microservices, and model-serving workloads in containers.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in Azure AI Document Intelligence, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure Cosmos DB, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
